controls.control: Client encrypts draft files and manifest before service upload; server has no content key.
controls.required_evidence: Exact-source service compromise exercise including objects, logs, backups and provider credentials.

controls.control: Fresh 256-bit file keys, allowed AEAD and unique 96-bit prefix/counter nonces; bounded chunks.
controls.required_evidence: Known-answer/provider tests and nonce/key reuse adversarial tests.

controls.control: Bind manifest digest, file/position/count/length; authenticate before rendering and verify final hash.
controls.required_evidence: Reorder, truncation, replay, substitution, wrong range/length and premature plaintext release failures.

controls.control: Deliver file keys/private manifests only through authenticated E2EE parent messages in the same flow.
controls.required_evidence: Reviewed protocol library/provider and membership-bound key delivery; negative configuration test is not runtime evidence.

controls.section: 2. Account identity is not cryptographic authority
controls.control: Root-authorized device state is separate from SIWE/Safe login; service cannot enroll recipients.
controls.required_evidence: Server-only enrollment/replay rejection and signed exact preceding-state transitions.

controls.control: Explicit unlock and authenticated local vault; Argon2id v0x13 meets an upstream RFC 9106 floor.
controls.required_evidence: Reviewed browser-capable implementation, bounded memory, crash consistency and unavailable-key recovery.

controls.control: Fresh backup keys, client-held recovery secret, prior device authorization and independently assessed rollback anchor.
controls.required_evidence: Lost/all-device recovery design, stale backup rejection, provider-compromise test and no signing-key reuse.

controls.control: Disclose hosted origin trust; do not claim malicious-origin prevention or hardware isolation.
controls.required_evidence: Reviewed user disclosures plus exact deployed-browser inspection.

controls.control: Bind complete executable closure, independent trust roots, signed update metadata and rollback/freeze protections.
controls.required_evidence: Authenticated artifact/signature verification and rollback/freeze/partial update failures.

controls.control: Real independent log and witness, continuity proofs and no invented independence.
controls.required_evidence: Authenticated operator/ownership assessment and verified log/witness proofs.

controls.control: HTTPS/HSTS, exact hash-authorized CSP/SRI, safe DOM, frame isolation, no third-party code in key context or plaintext local storage.
controls.required_evidence: Browser injection, origin/source messaging, CSRF and executable-byte tests.

controls.control: Active service ciphertext retention no greater than 30 days; long-term private archives require a reviewed resolution.
controls.required_evidence: Bounded cleanup across primary, replica, orphan, queue, backup and cache paths.

controls.section: 4. Metadata, operations and deliberate endpoint services
controls.control: Minimize and encrypt service metadata at rest; keep keys and draft content out of telemetry.
controls.required_evidence: Redacted diagnostics, schema/access inventory, quota/budget and metadata-at-rest provider checks.

controls.section: 4. Metadata, operations and deliberate endpoint services
controls.control: Public upload only after explicit selected-byte declassification; cancel makes no public object.
controls.required_evidence: Cancel/retry boundary tests, legal-byte/hash round trip and private-collector metadata exclusion.

controls.control: Exact-source independent review, locked transitive dependencies, SBOM, signed provenance and reproduced artifact.
controls.required_evidence: Authenticated independent reviewer report, signed artifacts and independent byte reproduction.

controls.control: Configuration consistency, implementation evidence, deployed state and certification remain separate.
controls.required_evidence: No runtime/certification claims from diagnostics; authenticated exact-scope external verification.
